- [USER] User requested more information about specific projects the Višnjan Observatory worked on with other centers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Višnjan Observatory collaborated with the Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics on the "Killer Asteroids" project, discovering several minor planets and comets with potential Earth impact.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Višnjan Observatory participated in the "Rosetta mission" with the European Space Agency, studying Comet 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The observatory worked with the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan to study Kuiper Belt objects and their orbital characteristics.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Višnjan Observatory collaborated with the Belgrade Astronomical Observatory on the "Eclipse Project," studying solar eclipses and their effects on the Earth's atmosphere.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The observatory partnered with the Nicolaus Copernicus Astronomical Center of the Polish Academy of Sciences to study binary stars and their properties.
